title: Bioavailability of heavy metals in fish from Rawal lake and its health risk assessment using an in vitro digestion model
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00466G, Paper
Open Access

Nazia Bibi, Muhammad Tariq Rafiq, Rukhsanda Aziz, Shahid Mahmood, Muhammad Zubair-ul Hassan Arsalan, Laila Battool
HMs in Rawal lake water exceeded WHO limits and accumulated more in bottom-feeding fish. As, Cd, Ni, and Cr were the major contributors to carcinogenic risk in both fisherfolk and the general population.
